description: Defines classes and functions related to 'STACK CFI' register recovery rules, including CFIFrameInfo, rule parsing, and stack walking utilities for debugging and exception handling.

classes.name: CFIFrameInfo
classes.description: Holds 'STACK CFI'-derived register recovery rules for a specific instruction.

classes.name: CFIRuleParser
classes.description: Parses STACK CFI-style rule sets into internal rule representations.

classes.name: CFIFrameInfoParseHandler
classes.description: Populates a CFIFrameInfo instance during rule set parsing.

classes.name: SimpleCFIWalker
classes.description: A utility class template for stack walking based on CFI rules, architecture-specific.

methods.name: SetCFARule
methods.description: Sets the expression for computing the call frame address.

methods.name: SetRARule
methods.description: Sets the expression for computing the return address.

methods.name: SetRegisterRule
methods.description: Sets the rule for recovering a specific register.

methods.name: FindCallerRegs
methods.description: Computes caller register values based on current register states, memory, and CFI rules.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the CFI rules into a string format.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a rule set string into internal rule representations.

methods.name: CFARule
methods.description: Handles a CFA rule during parsing.

methods.name: RARule
methods.description: Handles a return address rule during parsing.

methods.name: RegisterRule
methods.description: Handles a register recovery rule during parsing.
